source: USGS 3DEP 2020 lidar (public domain), OpenStreetMap (ODbL); see CREDITS.md
pole_format: e, n, top (NAVD88 m), ground, kind, facing (rad, ENU from east)
blob_format: 1 m columns: o = centre of the NW column (ENU m), w x h, rows north->south; top/bot = zlib+base64 u16 (z + 10) * 10, 0 = empty
bridge_format: deck top on 1 m posts: zlib+base64 u16 (z + 10) * 20; o = NW post centre
